title: Band Name Generator
description: Asks for the city you grew up in and the name of a pet, then combines them into a band name.

title: Tip Calculator
description: Splits a restaurant bill between friends and adds the tip percentage you choose.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Play rock, paper, scissors against the computer, which picks its move at random.

title: Hangman
description: Guess a hidden word one letter at a time before the drawing of the hangman is complete.

title: Blackjack
description: A game of blackjack against the dealer: draw cards and try to reach 21 without going over.

title: Snake Game
description: The classic snake game drawn with turtle graphics: eat the food, grow longer and avoid the walls.

title: Flash Card App
description: A Tkinter app that shows French words and flips each card to the English meaning to help you learn.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This site: a portfolio generated from JSON files with the Python standard library and shown by a local server.
